description: S25: grants the injected titlebar's three window-control commands to the local dsh GUI origin (the webview only ever navigates to the shell-spawned server, whose port is OS-picked, hence the port wildcard). Residual risk, accepted: any 127.0.0.1 page the main window ever navigates to inherits these three nuisance-level commands (no arguments, no data, no exec). Nothing else is exposed to the remote page.
